clips.text: I do have news. But you go first. I can wait.
clips.script: [blurting, fast] I [emphasized] DO have news. [very strained] But you go first. [pause] [tight, quick] I can wait.

clips.text: Hey, babe. You've got your news face on.
clips.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, greeting] hey, babe. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, teasing] you've got your news face on.

clips.text: RUMBLE. A flash woke me up. Now everybody runs.
clips.script: [huge, very deep] RUMBLE. [accusatory, slow] A flash woke me up. [very sad] Now everybody runs.

clips.text: Everything's fine. Everything's fine.
clips.script: [heavy Salvadoran accent, dazed] Everything's fine. [heavy Salvadoran accent, droning] Everything's fine.

clips.text: This gumbo is perfect. Doesn't need a thing.
clips.script: [thick Louisiana Creole accent, dazed] This gumbo is perfect. [thick Louisiana Creole accent, droning] Doesn't need a thing.

clips.text: Ahem. You're in my way.
clips.script: [wet cough] Ahem. [rude, very flat] You're in my way.

clips.text: No parking Saturdays. Noon to two. You parked.
clips.script: [reciting, fast] No parking Saturdays. Noon to two. [accusatory, very flat] You parked.

clips.text: Morning, Tom! Back from your folks? How's your mama?
clips.script: [older African American man, warm Louisiana drawl, thick Louisiana drawl, very cheerful, loud] Morning, Tom! [older African American man, warm Louisiana drawl, thick Louisiana drawl, asking] Back from your folks? [older African American man, warm Louisiana drawl, thick Louisiana drawl, very cheerful] How's your mama?

clips.text: Tata, don't touch it! Send me a picture of both. And don't let Nara lick it.
clips.script: [bossy, loud] Tata, don't touch it! [ordering, quick] Send me a picture of both. [very stern] And don't let Nara lick it.

clips.text: Dog. Run with us. We never sit.
clips.script: [low, growling] Dog. [eager, fast] Run with us. [taunting] We never sit.

clips.text: A FISH was wearing my mom's muffin pan. As a crown. I'm so sorry. Please. Toast.
clips.script: [blurting, very fast] A [emphasized] FISH was wearing my mom's muffin pan. [very flat] As a crown. [pause] [sheepish, quick] I'm so sorry. Please. [strained] Toast.

clips.text: Sure. So I got up this morning, and I was thinking about toast...
clips.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, slow] sure. so i got up this morning, [mellow, laid-back, low-key, trailing off] and i was thinking about toast...

clips.text: RUMBLE. ...Nobody asks. They just run.
clips.script: [huge, astounded] RUMBLE. [very quiet, slow] ...Nobody asks. [very sad] They just run.

clips.text: Perfect. You cook so well, Tom.
clips.script: [heavy Salvadoran accent, dazed] Perfect. [heavy Salvadoran accent, very flat] You cook so well, Tom.

clips.text: Sit down, both of you. This gumbo needs salt and you two need lunch.
clips.script: [thick Louisiana Creole accent, commanding] Sit down, both of you. [thick Louisiana Creole accent, complaining, quick] This gumbo needs salt [thick Louisiana Creole accent, informing] and you two need lunch.

clips.text: Ahem. There's two of us.
clips.script: [wet cough] Ahem. [taunting, flat] There's two of us.

clips.text: Denied.
clips.script: [very very flat, final] Denied.

clips.text: Glad to hear it. Tell her I said hello.
clips.script: [older African American man, warm Louisiana drawl, thick Louisiana drawl, very relaxed] Glad to hear it. [older African American man, warm Louisiana drawl, thick Louisiana drawl, very cheerful] Tell her I said hello.

clips.text: Big. No, sorry. TAXI big.
clips.script: [informing, flat] Big. [quick, correcting] No, sorry. [emphasized] TAXI big.

clips.text: No, yours wins. How big a fish?
clips.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, conceding] no, yours wins. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, very curious] how big a fish?
